name: Assembly Bay
description: A Workshop Assembler set to build Engines, on a 4 m slab with a second slab beside it: a Materials Bin of steel and a Parts Shelf of Piston Sets and Wiring Looms feed it by chute, and a battery powers it. An Engine is physics-only, so each one leaves as a body at the Assembler's open front. Change the recipe with the configure tool; what it puts on its tray goes down a chute to the Chest.
